The Parliament deliberated and adopted,
the President of the Republic hereby
enacts the law set out be/ow:

SECTION 1: The President of the Republic is authorized to ratify the Bilateral
Air Services Agreement between the Government of the Republic of
Cameroon and the Government of the State of Qatar, signed in Doha on 16
January 2025, for the operation of air services between their respective
territories and beyond. m
SECTION 2: This law shall be registered, published according to the
procedure of urgency and inserted in the Official Gazette in English and
French. ./-
